data.long_meaning: Ak means the 'Prince' and Ther means 'Lord' or 'King'. It is a name for a royal and noble child. The name Akther carries the meaning “Prince” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Akther usually hope their child will grow to embody prince and live with faith, good character and purpose.
